name: Greenhouse job boards
description: Employer job boards hosted by Greenhouse: list every opening on a board, search it with Greenhouse's own keyword, department and office filters, read one post with its description, pay ranges and application questions, and enumerate a board's departments and offices. response.description_html:
Discord is a voice, video and text platform that helps friends come together to hang out, play games and have fun. When Jason Citron and Stanislav Vishnevskiy founded Discord in 2015 they had a hunch that multiplayer gaming would be the future of entertainment and that people would need a communications platform designed for them to talk with their gaming friends. Today, gaming has become the largest form of entertainment in the world, bigger than movies and music combined. It’s the fastest-growing as well.

 

Discord makes it feel like you’re playing in the same room with friends. Discord users can communicate through 1:1 direct messages (DMs), group direct messages (GDMs) and Servers where friends can easily gather in voice, text and video chats before, during and after gaming. High quality streaming and a seamless experience across devices lets people play and interact together as if they were in person. Almost all activity on Discord happens in small, private friend spaces.

Discord plays a uniquely important role in the future of gaming. We are focused on making it easier and more fun for people to talk and hang out before, during, and after playing games.

So if this strikes a chord, come join us in our mission! Explore our latest job listings and apply today!

response.content_html:
Discord has a highly engaged community of millions of daily active users who use the platform for many different reasons, but there’s one thing that nearly everyone does: play video games. Discord plays a uniquely important role in the future of gaming, and we are focused on making it easier and more fun for people to hang out before, during, and after playing games.

Creators are people who build audiences across the internet: influential voices whose communities listen to them and want to spend time together. Many of those communities already live on Discord, but our relationship with creators has grown organically. We have an opportunity to listen more closely, serve them more intentionally, and build a relationship that reflects the role they play on our platform.

We’re hiring a Senior Staff Program Manager to build Discord’s approach to creators from the ground up. You’ll begin with a selected group of creators already using Discord, build the fundamentals that serve them well, and develop programs that make their experience on Discord better. Over time, you’ll turn what works into programs that can serve creators at scale and, eventually, give new creators more reasons to choose Discord. This is a senior individual contributor role for someone who can lead through judgment, relationships, and execution. You’ll report to the Director of Marketing, Player Communications and partner closely with Support, Product, Marketing, Communications, Partnerships, Policy, and more.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Build Discord’s creator strategy from the bottom up, starting with direct conversations and a clear understanding of what creators already on Discord need from us.
  • Bring together the creator work that exists across Discord today, establish clear ownership, and turn a collection of early efforts into a coherent program.
  • Define who we mean by creators and develop an initial approach for selecting and serving a trusted group across games, platforms, formats, and communities.
  • Create more than one program for creators, beginning with the fundamentals: accelerated support, clear paths for escalation, and reliable channels for two-way communication.
  • Manage relationships with important creators directly. Understand how they use Discord, help them solve meaningful problems, and build trust by following through.
  • Build a creator council or network that gives us a consistent view of what creators are seeing, where Discord is falling short, and what would make the platform more useful to them and their communities.
  • Build systems and playbooks that let a selected program grow over time without losing the relationships and responsiveness that made it valuable.

What you should have

  • A strong passion for Discord and/or gaming, and an appreciation for the creators and communities we serve.
  • 7+ years in creator partnerships, community, platform programs, marketing, product partnerships, or a related field.
  • Deeply familiar with how creators build audiences, operate their businesses, and manage communities across platforms like YouTube, Twitch, TikTok, Instagram, Patreon, Reddit, and Discord.
  • You have built and operated creator or partner programs at scale, and you understand how to begin with a selected group without designing something that can never grow beyond it.
  • Biased to ship and iterate. You can launch a useful first version, learn from it, and raise the ambition over time.
  • Comfortable leading as an individual contributor. You create alignment and momentum across teams without relying on headcount or reporting lines.
  • An excellent cross-functional partner across Support, Product, Marketing, Comms, Partnerships, Policy, and more.

Bonus Points

  • You have built a creator, partner, ambassador, advisory, or VIP program for a consumer platform.
  • You have designed accelerated support or escalation programs for influential users.
  • You have worked directly with gaming creators and understand the relationship between creators, games, and communities.
  • You have built programs involving product access, creator events, recognition, or discovery.
  • You have helped turn creator feedback into product changes, policies, or platform strategy.
  • You have built a program that began with a small trusted group and expanded without losing what made it valuable.

The US base salary range for this full-time position is $256,000 to $288,000 + equity + benefits. Our salary ranges are determined by role and level. Within the range, individual pay is determined by additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Please note that the compensation details listed in US role postings reflect the base salary only, and do not include equity, or benefits.

Candidates must reside in or be willing to relocate to the San Francisco Bay Area (Alameda, Contra Costa, Marin, Napa, San Francisco, San Mateo, Santa Clara, Solano, and Sonoma counties). Relocation assistance may be available. 

Why Discord? 

Discord plays a uniquely important role in the future of gaming. We're a multiplatform, multigenerational and multiplayer platform that helps people deepen their friendships around games and shared interests, and helps developers build and grow their businesses. We believe games give us a way to have fun with our favorite people, whether listening to music together or grinding in competitive matches for diamond rank. Join us in our mission! Your future is just a click away!

Discord is committed to inclusion and providing reasonable accommodations during the interview process. We want you to feel set up for success, so if you are in need of reasonable accommodations, please let your recruiter know.

Please see our Applicant and Candidate Privacy Policy for details regarding Discord’s collection and usage of personal information relating to the application and recruitment process by clicking HERE.

tools.name: Jobs
tools.description: Start here with a board token to enumerate every opening with id, title, location, requisition id, dates and the public job URL. Pass next_page back as page. Use search for the board's own server-side keyword, department and office filters, and job for descriptions and application questions.

options.name: board_token
options.about: The employer's Greenhouse board token: the slug in https://job-boards.greenhouse.io/<board_token> or boards.greenhouse.io/embed/job_board?for=<board_token> (e.g. discord, gitlab). Case-insensitive. Pattern: ^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_-]{0,99}$.

options.name: keyword
options.about: Case-insensitive substring matched against title and location by this program (the API has no filter). Whitespace-only is rejected.

options.name: page
options.about: 1-based page over the (filtered) list; pass next_page back here.

options.name: per_page
options.about: Items per page.

options.name: url
options.about: A pasted Greenhouse board URL on job-boards.greenhouse.io, boards.greenhouse.io (including /embed/job_board?for=<token>) or boards-api.greenhouse.io/v1/boards/<token>. Exactly one of board_token or url. Pattern: ^https?://.

response.about: All open job posts on an employer's Greenhouse board from the public Job Board API (GET /v1/boards/<token>/jobs, unpaginated upstream), served in pages of per_page with an optional case-insensitive keyword filter over title and location applied by this program.

fields.name: absolute_url
fields.about: Public job page; the application form is on this page.

fields.name: application_deadline
fields.about: ISO 8601 deadline when the employer set one; null otherwise.

fields.name: first_published
fields.about: ISO 8601 with the employer's UTC offset, as the API returns it.

fields.name: id
fields.about: Job post id; pass to job as job_id.

fields.name: internal_job_id
fields.about: Greenhouse internal job (requisition) id.

fields.name: location
fields.about: Location as the employer wrote it (free text); null when the post has none.

fields.name: metadata
fields.about: Public custom fields the employer exposes on the board, verbatim names.

fields.name: requisition_id
fields.about: Employer's own requisition id; null when not set.

fields.name: updated_at
fields.about: ISO 8601 with the employer's UTC offset, as the API returns it.
